english.title: Solemnize a marriage after the expiration of the applicable period
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly and wilfully solemnized a marriage between **(..SPECIFY PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..) on the authority of certificates of a superintendent registrar at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) after **(..SPECIFY THE DATE OF EXPIRATION OF APPLICABLE PERIOD..), being the expiration of the period which was, in relation to that marriage, the applicable period for the purposes of section 33 of the Marriage Act 1949
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(2)(e) of the Marriage Act 1949.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The term 'certificates of a superintendent registrar' is substituted by a 'marriage schedule' from the 4th May 2021 by the Marriage Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/411). For offences which occur from this date, see H22867
